errors.evidence: The description starts with the very generic phrase "The graph illustrates the change of a value over time" but fails to provide any specific context about what the chart represents, even in general terms (e.g., "a line chart showing the trend of an unnamed variable..."). The reference description, while having external information, shows the importance of defining the subject matter (GDP per capita).

errors.text_span: След това линията намалява до стойност около 21500 през 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line decreases between 2013 and 2014. In fact, the line increases from approximately 20,200 to 20,800. The stated value of 21,500 is also incorrect for 2014; it is the approximate value for 2015.

errors.text_span: До 2015 г. линията намалява до около 20500.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line decreases to 20,500 by 2015. In reality, the line increases to a peak of approximately 21,500 in 2015.

errors.text_span: От 2015 до 2017 г. линията се покачва до около 21000 без съществени промени.
errors.evidence: This description is completely wrong. Between 2015 and 2017, the line shows a significant dip in 2016 (from ~21,500 down to ~20,600) and then a recovery to ~21,200 in 2017. It does not simply rise without significant changes.
The value for 2018 is clearly below the 22500 gridline, at approximately 22,300. Stating it is 22,500 is a significant overestimation.
